idea-plugin.name: ColorPeek
idea-plugin.description:
ColorPeek provides Java and Kotlin code with the gutter color preview and editing experience familiar from Android Studio resource files.

Color values are shown as swatches beside the source line. Click a swatch to open the IDE color picker; ColorPeek writes the selected value back through PSI while preserving source formatting.

Features

  • Java string literal and Kotlin literal string template support.
  • RGB, ARGB, RRGGBB, and AARRGGBB values with # or 0x/0X prefixes.
  • Independent Java and Kotlin controls.
  • Optional eight-digit ARGB numeric color previews, with separate string/numeric controls and Compose Color avoidance enabled by default.
  • Extensible language providers for future Rust, Python, and other language support.

Settings: Settings/Preferences → Tools → ColorPeek
